text:
pagerduty-bot: SEV2 Pager — gateway-streaming — Elevated 5xx spike + increased client disconnects detected. 5xx rate peaked at ~12% over baseline in us-west-2. Affected: streaming endpoints (chunked responses). Pager: alice (oncall)

alice (oncall): I'm on it. started looking at dashboards — spike starts ~16:08 UTC. Are we seeing a deploy around then?

deploy-bot: Deploy notice: service/gateway-streaming rolled (commit abc123) at 16:07:49 UTC by @frank.

ben (eng-runtime): Logs show a lot of errors like "unexpected EOF while reading chunk" and "client canceled stream" from the gateway. Backend model workers are returning 200s but with delayed first-chunk. Sequence: gateway times out, sends 502 to client. Also seeing a lot of "nghttp2: stream error" entries.

carla (eng-sre): Graphs: gateway queue depth and accept latency both jumped ~3x. TCP retransmits also up. Sending link to chart: https://grafana.redwood/gateway/streaming?from=16:00&to=16:20 (posted)

frank (infra): I can spin up extra gateway replicas and bump the frontend accept backlog. Will do a quick scale to 8 pods now.

frank (infra): (command) kubectl scale deploy/gateway-streaming -n prod --replicas=8

alice (oncall): Good. Also, can we check keepalive/heartbeat behavior? We had recent changes to chunked keepalive TTL in the LB config. Could be clients hitting an idle cutoff and then immediate reconnects causing thrash.

ben (eng-runtime): Confirmed: there was a config tweak to chunked keepalive at 15:59 that reduced server-side heartbeat from 30s -> 10s. That increases churn. Reverting to 30s for now.

carla (eng-sre): Reverting LB config now. (command) curl -X POST https://infra-api/configs/lb -d '{"streaming_keepalive":30}' 

alice (oncall): Also seeing repeated "partial-chunk" errors in gateway logs, looks like client cancels mid-chunk. Suggest enabling graceful chunk trailer handling and increasing request timeout from 30s -> 60s as a temporary mitigation.

frank (infra): Increasing gateway node ulimit and net.core.somaxconn to reduce accept drops. Applying sysctl changes to nodes in us-west-2.

frank (infra): (command) ssh node-12 'sudo sysctl -w net.core.somaxconn=1024 net.ipv4.tcp_max_syn_backlog=2048'

ben (eng-runtime): Backend model workers show KV cache miss rate increased ~4x causing slower first-token latencies — could explain delayed initial chunks. Looks like a warm/cold cache pattern after the deploy.

alice (oncall): Can we route a slice of traffic to the warm variant / quantized model to reduce latency? We can do 25% to fallback while cache warms.

ben (eng-runtime): Yes. Applying routing policy: route 25% of streaming traffic for model-prod to model-prod-quant-warm.

deploy-bot: Traffic split applied: model-prod => 75% model-prod / 25% model-prod-quant-warm (canary routing).

carla (eng-sre): After scale + keepalive revert + routing, 5xx dropped from 12% -> 2.1% within 3 minutes. Connectivity error rate (client disconnects) trending down too. Still seeing isolated chunk-truncation errors.

dinesh (support): Noted customer impact: 3 customer-facing incidents opened. Acme Corp (dedicated) reported streaming failures at ~16:10. CS has escalated and provided request ids.

alice (oncall): Share sample request ids and full traces please, we'll match across gateway and worker logs. Example id: req-8112c4.

ben (eng-runtime): Found trace for req-8112c4 -> gateway accepted, backend delayed 2.4s to first-chunk due to cache miss, client aborted at 2.9s. Gateway returned 502. Root cause chain looks like cold KV-cache + aggressive client-side timeouts + lowered keepalive.

alice (oncall): Current status: mitigations applied (scale, keepalive revert, routing split, sysctl). Monitoring for 15m. Action: continue traffic split until worker-level cache stabilizes.

frank (infra): Also applied a temporary per-connection send-window increase on gateway to reduce fragmentation.

carla (eng-sre): Rolling window 5xx% now at 0.7% and trending down. Latency p50 first-chunk dropped back to expected. Marking incident as "mitigated" for now but not closed.

alice (oncall): Good. Next steps: 1) postmortem doc + timeline, 2) revert canary once cache warmed and verify 5xx stable, 3) add alert for sudden keepalive config changes, 4) evaluate default client timeout guidance in SDK. I'll create tickets.

eva (product): Heads-up: notify any customers with dedicated instances about the temporary routing change and the expected reduced performance while cache warms. Dinesh please coordinate comms.

dinesh (support): Will draft customer note and ping affected accounts.

carla (eng-sre): Scheduling follow-up oncall handoff at 17:30 UTC to cover trailing checks.

alice (oncall): Thanks all. Leaving thread open for the postmortem. If we see re-escalation ping @here. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: Incident status updated -> MITIGATED at 16:20:34 UTC. Assigned: alice, ben, carla, frank, dinesh.

alice (oncall): Postmortem owner assigned: ben. ETA draft in 24h.

ben (eng-runtime): Will take PM. Notes for postmortem: root cause = cache cold + too-aggressive keepalive tweak in LB + immediate deploy at scale. Mitigations listed above.

carla (eng-sre): Adding runbook item: when seeing chunked partial-truncation errors, check keepalive and traffic split to warm variants before scaling back.

alice (oncall): Last check: 5xx at 0.4% now. Closing paging.

frank (infra): Leaving the extra replicas for 30m to ensure steady state, then scale down if stable.

alice (oncall): Thanks everyone.
